catalogMaintenance.explanation: A verified backup of the catalog is made first. Only reduced copies made by PicLib are removed: your photos and their XMP files are never touched. PicLib may slow down while the catalog is rebuilt.

catalogMaintenance.crashed: An internal error stopped the cleanup. Details are in the PicLib log.
